value.rationale: Commuting idempotents are compatible retractions, so their finite subsemilattices and extension/maximality are natural intrinsic transformation-semigroup invariants. All finite compatible retraction families, even for nonabelian labels, reduce to unlabelled transformations by one conjugation; the exact group-order orbit factor handles arbitrary higher arity and equivariant homogeneous G-set endomorphism monoids. Not a routine small-rank adjustment or repackaged known single/pair counts.
